aka.en: Northern, Central and Southern Second Freeway

tagline.en: Taiwan's longest freeway, laid inland of Freeway 1 to miss the cities and reach the towns
tagline.zh: 台湾最长的高速公路，走在国道一号内侧，避开大城，串起乡镇

start.en: Jijin interchange at Dawulun, Anle District, Keelung, on the road to Keelung harbour's west side
start.zh: 基隆市安乐区大武仑基金交流道，衔接基隆港西岸联外道路

end.en: Dapeng Bay, Linbian, Pingtung — the end since 2008, when the road was carried past the old Linbian terminus to the bay's ring road
end.zh: 屏东县林边乡大鹏湾端——2008 年自原林边端延伸至大鹏湾环湾道路后的新终点

en: National Freeway 3 runs the length of western Taiwan, 431.5 km of main line from Keelung to Linbian in Pingtung, through sixteen cities and counties. It is the island's longest freeway, and with its branch to central Taipei it is the backbone of a second north–south system built alongside Freeway 1.

Its route was chosen to do something Freeway 1 did not. Where the first freeway joins the big western cities in a near-straight line, the second avoids the dense cores and goes through foothill towns and farmland — to relieve Freeway 1, to spread development, and to keep land costs and short commuter trips down. North of Hsinchu it keeps to the hills; from Hsinchu to Changhua it runs near the coast; south of Changhua it follows the foot of the mountains all the way down.

Land acquisition bent it into an unusual shape in the middle. Between Taichung and Changhua the freeway turns east–west, crossing the Wu River twice, so that Changhua county is only skirted on its northern edge. It is also the road that gave Nantou, Taiwan's one landlocked county, a freeway.
zh: 国道三号纵贯台湾西部，主线自基隆至屏东林边全长 431.5 公里，途经十六个县市。它是岛上最长的高速公路，连同通往台北市区的支线，构成与国道一号并行的第二套南北向骨干。
它的选线刻意做了国道一号没做的事。第一条高速公路以近乎直线串起西部大城；第二条则避开人口稠密的市区，穿过麓山带的乡镇与农村——既为分担国道一号，也为平衡城乡，还能压低用地成本、避开短途通勤车流。新竹以北走丘陵，新竹至彰化靠近海岸，彰化以南则一路沿山而下。
用地问题使它在中段走出一个罕见的形状：台中与彰化之间，主线转为东西走向，两度跨越乌溪，彰化县因此只被它从北缘擦过。它也是让南投——台湾唯一不靠海的县——第一次接上高速公路的那条路。

en: The main line was designed for 120 km/h, except in the hill sections of the north, at 90–100. The Freeway Bureau counts 358 bridges and 17 tunnels, two of the tunnels on the Taipei link; bridges are about 36.5 per cent of the main line (157.5 km) and tunnels 3.2 per cent (13.7 km). Nine of the main-line tunnels are in the hills on the south side of the Taipei basin; the longest is Muzha, 1,875 m.

The northern tunnels were the hardest work. Muzha's ground squeezed in as it was dug, losing 1.8 m of a 9.1 m section, and was held with rock bolts and re-excavated. Wider lanes than Freeway 1 — 3.75 m, with a 3 m shoulder — became the standard for later freeway work.

The two bridges the engineers point to are the Bitan Bridge over the Xindian River, a three-span prestressed concrete arch with a 160 m main span designed by T. Y. Lin, Taiwan's first long-span prestressed arch; and the Kaoping River cable-stayed bridge into Pingtung, 510 m long, with a single 183.5 m A-shaped tower and an asymmetric 330 m steel main span and 180 m concrete side span. The Touqian River bridge at Hsinchu, finished in May 1992, was the first in Taiwan built by incremental launching.
There are no wartime runway sections, unlike Freeway 1.
zh: 主线设计时速 120 公里，仅北部丘陵与山岭路段为 90 至 100 公里。高速公路局统计全线有桥梁 358 座、隧道 17 座，其中两座隧道位于台北联络线；主线桥梁约占 36.5%（157.5 公里），隧道占 3.2%（13.7 公里）。主线隧道有九座集中在台北盆地南侧的山区，最长的是 1,875 米的木栅隧道。
北部隧道是最难的工程。木栅隧道开挖时断面向内挤缩，9.1 米高的断面缩了 1.8 米，最后以岩栓固定岩壁后重新开挖才得以完成。比国道一号更宽的车道（每车道 3.75 米，外路肩 3 米）后来成为国道工程的标准。
工程界常举的两座桥，北为碧潭大桥，跨新店溪，为三跨预力混凝土拱桥，最大跨径 160 米，由林同棪设计，是台湾第一座大跨径预力混凝土拱桥；南为高屏溪斜张桥，主桥长 510 米，单座 A 形桥塔高 183.5 米，主跨 330 米为钢构、侧跨 180 米为混凝土，不对称布置。新竹的头前溪桥于 1992 年 5 月完工，是台湾第一座以节块推进工法施工的桥梁。
与国道一号不同，全线没有设置战备跑道。

en: Freeway 1 was filling up within a few years of opening in 1978. In 1983 the Freeway Bureau began studying a northern metropolitan network, and work on the Northern Second Freeway — 108 km from Xizhi to Hsinchu, with the Taoyuan beltway and the Taipei link — started in June 1987.

For the rest of the road five corridors were studied: coastal, inland, and combinations. The Executive Yuan approved the combined option, coastal north of Hemei and inland south of Wufeng, in July 1989. In 1990 the National Expressway Engineering Bureau was formed to build both programmes.

The first section, Tucheng to Sanying, opened on 19 January 1993, and the northern programme was complete on 24 August 1997. Sections further south opened from 1999. The 1999 Jiji earthquake cost the programme about a year. The main line was finished on 11 January 2004, when the Longjing–Kuaiguan section in Taichung opened. After a public naming contest the road was called the Formosa Freeway.

On 25 April 2010 a hillside slid onto the freeway about 3 km from its northern end in Keelung, bringing down an overpass and burying all six lanes over some 200 m; four people died, and the section was closed until 1 June.
zh: 国道一号 1978 年通车后没几年就趋于饱和。1983 年高速公路局开始办理北部都会区路网研究；北二高计划——自汐止至新竹 108 公里，含桃园内环线及台北联络线——于 1987 年 6 月动工。
其余路段研究了五个路廊方案：滨海线、内陆线及两者的组合。1989 年 7 月，行政院核定和美以北走滨海、雾峰以南走内陆的组合方案（C 线）。1990 年成立交通部台湾区国道新建工程局，统筹兴建北二高与二高后续计划。
首段土城至三莺于 1993 年 1 月 19 日通车，北二高于 1997 年 8 月 24 日全线完成；中南部路段自 1999 年起陆续通车。1999 年九二一大地震使工程又延误约一年。2004 年 1 月 11 日，台中龙井至快官段通车，主线全线贯通；经公开征名，定名为福尔摩沙高速公路。
2010 年 4 月 25 日，基隆境内距北端约 3 公里处边坡滑落，压垮横跨国道的跨越桥，土石掩埋双向六车道约两百多米，造成 4 人死亡，该路段封闭至 6 月 1 日。

en: It was the largest public works project the government had undertaken in Taiwan. The Executive Yuan approved NT$170.81 billion for the Northern Second Freeway and NT$525.1 billion for the follow-on programme, which also covered branch freeways; with NT$15.27 billion for the Changbin–Kuaiguan east–west expressway, the total was NT$711.18 billion. Land alone came to NT$136.8 billion for 4,854 hectares.

It came in well under. By the time the last contracts were let in 1999, land had cost NT$98.8 billion less than estimated — prices had not risen as they had during the northern section, and more viaduct meant less land — and works NT$127.8 billion less. With NT$27.6 billion of contingency unused, the former head of the engineering bureau puts the saving at NT$254.2 billion, returned to the treasury.
Tolls are by distance, as on all national freeways.
zh: 这是政府迁台以来最大的公共工程。行政院核定北二高预算 1,708.1 亿元、二高后续计划（含环支线）5,251 亿元，另纳入东西向快速公路彰滨快官段 152.7 亿元，总计 7,111.8 亿元。仅用地费就达 1,368 亿元，取得用地 4,854 公顷。
最后花得远比预算少。至 1999 年下半年全部发包完成时，用地费比原估算少 988 亿元——地价未如北二高时期大涨，大量采用高架桥也减少了用地——工程费少 1,278 亿元；再加上未动用的预备费 276 亿元，前国工局长估计共节省新台币 2,542 亿元，全数缴回国库。
与所有国道一样，按里程收费。

en: The general limit is 110 km/h, and the road is mostly three lanes each way — eight lanes from Zhonghe to Yingge and from Wufeng to Zhongxing, four from Jiuru to Linbian. Heavy motorcycles over 550 cc are barred from the whole road.

Because Freeway 3 only skirts Changhua county, the county's traffic leans on Freeway 1, and drivers switch between the two at the Changhua junction; Freeway 1's Changhua section is a regular jam over the Lunar New Year holidays.
zh: 一般速限为每小时 110 公里；全线以双向六车道为主，中和至莺歌及雾峰至中兴为双向八车道，九如至林边为双向四车道。排气量 550 cc 以上的大型重型机车禁止行驶全线。
由于国道三号只从彰化县边缘擦过，该县车流仍倚重国道一号，驾驶人常在彰化系统交流道转换路线；国道一号彰化段每逢春节连假常严重塞车。

value.en: NT$711.18 billion approved for the Northern Second Freeway, the follow-on programme (with its branch freeways) and the Changbin–Kuaiguan expressway; the author reports NT$254.2 billion of it saved and returned to the treasury. Approved budgets, not audited outturn.
value.zh: 北二高、二高后续计划（含环支线）及彰滨快官段核定预算合计新台币 7,111.8 亿元；作者称其中节省 2,542 亿元缴回国库。以上为核定预算，非决算数。

figures.source: Cheng Wen-lung (鄭文隆, former director-general of the National Expressway Engineering Bureau), 「國道三號高速公路全線完工十周年回顧」, Modern Construction (現代營建) no. 421

value.zh: 4,854 公顷（北二高 1,415 公顷、二高后续计划 3,439 公顷），用地费 1,368 亿元

why.en: The sources give the Executive Yuan's approved budgets but not how they were financed (general budget, bonds or the national freeway fund).
why.zh: 所见资料只列出行政院核定预算，未说明其财源（普通预算、公债或国道基金）。

value.en: Freeway 3 with its Taipei link and the branch freeways built with it: 358 bridges, 17 tunnels, 74 service interchanges, 18 system interchanges, 7 service areas; main line about 432 km, 518 km with branches
value.zh: 国道三号连同台北联络线及同期兴建的环支线：桥梁 358 座、隧道 17 座、服务性交流道 74 处、系统交流道 18 处、服务区 7 处；主线约 432 公里，加计环支线 518 公里

figures.source: Freeway Bureau, 國道3號及國道2號、4號、8號、10號工程 (history pages of the National Expressway Engineering Bureau), 2018

value.en: National Expressway Engineering Bureau (from 1990); now maintained by the Freeway Bureau
value.zh: 交通部台湾区国道新建工程局（1990 年起）兴建；现由交通部高速公路局养护

figures.source: Freeway Bureau; Chinese Wikipedia, 福爾摩沙高速公路

timeline.en: Work starts on the Northern Second Freeway in June.
The Executive Yuan approves the route south of Hsinchu in July.
timeline.zh: 7 月，行政院核定新竹以南的二高后续计划路线。

timeline.en: The National Expressway Engineering Bureau is formed to build it.
timeline.zh: 成立国道新建工程局负责兴建。

timeline.en: The first section, Tucheng to Sanying, opens on 19 January.
timeline.zh: 1 月 19 日，首段土城至三莺通车。

timeline.en: The Northern Second Freeway is complete on 24 August.
timeline.zh: 8 月 24 日，北二高全线通车。

timeline.en: The main line opens throughout on 11 January and is named the Formosa Freeway.
timeline.zh: 1 月 11 日主线全线通车，定名福尔摩沙高速公路。

timeline.en: The extension from Linbian to Dapeng Bay opens on 25 February.
timeline.zh: 2 月 25 日，林边至大鹏湾延伸线通车。

timeline.en: A landslide near Qidu on 25 April buries the freeway and kills four.
timeline.zh: 4 月 25 日，七堵附近走山掩埋国道，4 人罹难。

timeline.en: Distance-based electronic tolling replaces the toll stations on 30 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 30 日，全面改为电子计程收费。
